commit.message: feat(loop-closure): hardening lane v1 — capped, draft-only, receipted

intent: PR-E of the walking-mode loop-closure plan: hardening lane v1 — a scheduled, capped, draft-only lane. One target per run selected from the mailbox ready-set (PR-D join) or the failing nightly; a fresh-context agent bounded by workflow-enforced caps (runtime, agent seconds, diff lines); green-tests exit; output only ever a draft PR labeled mike-watch + walk-ready entering the ruling's review pipeline; a receipt artifact per run, never committed.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import subprocess,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path('.github/workflows/hardening-lane.yml'); orig=p.read_text(); mut=orig.replace('Halt on loop kill-switch','DISABLED-guard',1); assert mut!=orig; p.write_text(mut); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','tests/test_hardening_lane.py','-q'],check=False); p.write_text(orig); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode!=0 else 2)"
negative_controls.name: removing-killswitch-guard-breaks-contract-test

honest_blockers: First live run requires the operator to configure the DHARMA_LANE_AGENT_CMD repo secret; without it the lane refuses with a BLOCKED receipt instead of improvising an agent.
The mailbox ready-set selection activates only after PR-D (dependency join) merges; until then selection falls through to the failing-nightly probe or a NO_WORK receipt.
Lane runs fire only from main after operator hand-merge of this Tier-2 workflow; the first receipt is provable post-merge only.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the single commit: the lane workflow, driver, and tests disappear. Any lane branches or draft PRs already opened remain inert drafts the operator can close.
